mapper.sql: w.IPWRK_NO, w.IPROM_NO, w.SSYS_ID, w.SSTATUS, w.SUSER_ID, w.SUSER_NM, SUBSTR(w.SINS_DT, 1, 16) AS SINS_DT, w.SREASON, w.SACT_NM
mapper.select: SELECT , p.STITLE AS PROM_TITLE, p.SGUBUN_ID AS PROM_GUBUN_ID, c.SNAME AS CATE_NM, b.ORGNZT_NM AS BUSEO_NM FROM TB_PROM_WRK w LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_PROM p ON w.IPROM_NO = p.IPROM_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CATE c ON p.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO b ON b.ORGNZT_ID = NVL(p.SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID, 'ORG_' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(p.IBUSEO_NO), 16, '0')) WHERE w.IPWRK_NO = #{workNo}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT , p.STITLE AS PROM_TITLE, p.SGUBUN_ID AS PROM_GUBUN_ID, c.SNAME AS CATE_NM, b.ORGNZT_NM AS BUSEO_NM FROM TB_PROM_WRK w LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_PROM p ON w.IPROM_NO = p.IPROM_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CATE c ON p.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO b ON b.ORGNZT_ID = NVL(p.SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID, 'ORG_' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(p.IBUSEO_NO), 16, '0')) WHERE w.IPROM_NO = #{promNo} ORDER BY w.SINS_DT DESC, w.IPWRK_NO DESC ) WHERE rownum = 1
SELECT , NULL AS PROM_TITLE, NULL AS PROM_GUBUN_ID, NULL AS CATE_NM, NULL AS BUSEO_NM FROM TB_PROM_WRK w WHERE w.IPROM_NO = #{promNo} ORDER BY w.SINS_DT DESC, w.IPWRK_NO DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROM_WRK w WHERE w.IPWRK_NO = ( SELECT MAX(w2.IPWRK_NO) FROM TB_PROM_WRK w2 WHERE w2.IPROM_NO = w.IPROM_NO ) AND w.SSTATUS = '승인요청' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_PROM p WHERE p.IPROM_NO = w.IPROM_NO )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROM_WRK w WHERE w.IPWRK_NO = ( SELECT MAX(w2.IPWRK_NO) FROM TB_PROM_WRK w2 WHERE w2.IPROM_NO = w.IPROM_NO ) AND w.SSTATUS = '승인반려' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_PROM p WHERE p.IPROM_NO = w.IPROM_NO ) AND ( SELECT r.SUSER_ID FROM TB_PROM_WRK r WHERE r.IPWRK_NO = ( SELECT MAX(r2.IPWRK_NO) FROM TB_PROM_WRK r2 WHERE r2.IPROM_NO = w.IPROM_NO AND r2.SSTATUS = '승인요청' ) ) = #{userId}
SELECT p.IPROM_NO FROM TB_PROM p WHERE p.IPROM_NO = #{promNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PROM_ACT_LOG ( IPALOG_NO, IPROM_NO, SSYS_ID, SREF_TABLE, IREF_NO, SACT_TYPE, SACT_NM, SACT_DC, SUSER_ID, SUSER_NM, SINS_DT, IPWRK_NO, SFIELD_LOG ) VALUES ( #{actLogNo}, #{promNo}, 'RLMS', #{refTable}, #{refNo}, #{actType}, #{actNm}, NVL(#{actDc,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ' '), NVL(#{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ' '), NVL(#{userNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ' ')), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), NVL(#{workNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), #{fieldLog,jdbcType=CLOB} )
mapper.select: SELECT IPALOG_NO, IPROM_NO, SSYS_ID, SREF_TABLE, IREF_NO, SACT_TYPE, SACT_NM, SACT_DC, SUSER_ID, SUSER_NM, SUBSTR(SINS_DT, 1, 16) AS SINS_DT, IPWRK_NO, SFIELD_LOG FROM TB_PROM_ACT_LOG WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo} ORDER BY SINS_DT DESC, IPALOG_NO DESC

where.if: AND ( UPPER(p.STITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(a.SACT_NM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(a.SACT_DC) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(a.SUSER_NM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) || '%' )

mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rownum rn, TB.* FROM ( SELECT a.IPALOG_NO, a.IPROM_NO, a.SSYS_ID, a.SREF_TABLE, a.IREF_NO, a.SACT_TYPE, a.SACT_NM, a.SACT_DC, a.SUSER_ID, a.SUSER_NM, SUBSTR(a.SINS_DT, 1, 16) AS SINS_DT, a.IPWRK_NO, p.STITLE AS PROM_TITLE FROM TB_PROM_ACT_LOG a LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_PROM p ON a.IPROM_NO = p.IPROM_NO
ORDER BY a.SINS_DT DESC, a.IPALOG_NO DESC ) TB ) WHERE rn BETWEEN #{firstIndex}+1 AND #{firstIndex}+#{recordCountPerPage}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROM_ACT_LOG a LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_PROM p ON a.IPROM_NO = p.IPROM_NO
